cases.question: Can jekyll-feed replace /atom.xml without conflicting with Chulapa?
cases.expected: Pointing jekyll-feed at /atom.xml conflicts with the built-in Atom feed. Recommend keeping theme feeds or using the plugin default /feed.xml with its setup guide. Do not invent a disable-feed YAML setting or claim the guide provides a replacement Ruby recipe.

cases.question: How do I write a Markdown table with right-aligned numbers and a fenced YAML example?
Does kramdown GFM support every Kramdown extension? How do I make a Markdown TOC?
cases.expected: GFM does not support every Kramdown extension. Guide /docs/58-content-toc uses two separate lines * Contents and {:toc}, outside a code fence in article content; verified on sample GFM. kramdown.toc_levels is site-wide and separate from show_toc/h_min/h_max. Preserve parser/options; publish and check generated links. Syntax specimens remain /docs/markdown-cheatsheet. Marker location only controls index position; .no_toc is shared by content and theme TOCs.
